listingTitle: Avoid synchronously waiting on C# tasks
title: Avoid synchronously waiting on C# tasks
why: Blocking on Task.Result or Wait ties up a thread and can deadlock when continuations need the captured synchronization context.
suggestion: Make the caller async and await the task so the thread can return to the scheduler.
limitations: GetAwaiter().GetResult() is reported directly; Result and Wait require an explicitly typed Task or ValueTask receiver, or a local var assigned directly from an unawaited Async-suffixed call.
Result and GetAwaiter().GetResult() guarded by a nearby IsCompleted or IsCompletedSuccessfully check are excluded; aliases, wrappers, and task types hidden behind interfaces are not inferred.
